meta.description: Lifts and lowers the margin of a cap in lobes around it, like the wavy margin of a chanterelle. Every ray bends in its own plane, so it keeps its length. Put it right after the cap and fill_gaps: it reads how far out a ray is on the open cap.

cap.description: The paths of the cap node: the rays of the caps and their stipes

waves.description: Lobes around the margin. Real chanterelles have about 4 to 8, thinner flesh gives more. Read for every stipe, so a random node gives every cap its own count. Here path_info length reads how long the rays of the cap are, so a round node can give a larger cap more lobes.

amplitude.description: How far the margin moves up and down, as a share of the radius: about 1 / waves for a wavy margin. A value alone waves the outer part of the cap. Connect a curve to set it from the centre (alpha 0) to the margin (alpha 1), the waves follow how it rises.

irregularity.description: How much the lobes vary in width and height, set by the seed. 0 = all alike and evenly spaced
